newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.3007 on Thursday against the U.S. dollar in slow trading from Wednesday's 8.3020 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, traders said.
The local unit opened higher at 8.3008 but fell to an intra-day low of 8.3015. It then moved to consolidate between 8.3005 and 8.3010 for the rest of the session.
Trading was duller than yesterday, with most done at 8.3008, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan was pushed up by buying at low levels but capped by strong selling at about 8.3000.
"No matter how the yuan moves, it seems difficult to breach the key 8.3000 level in the short term," said one dealer.
"The yuan moved below 8.30 in the past few days due to a lack of new stimulus," he added.
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.3010 on Friday.
The yuan closed up slightly at 7.3285 from 7.3331 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intra-day low of 1.0745 from 1.0725 against the Hong Kong dollar.
